description: self-recovery RESTARTED surrealdb after 2 consecutive ticks of a cheap RETURN 1 liveness probe timing out — the shared datastore was wedged in the MemoryHigh throttle zone (unresponsive without an OOM-kill, so it never self-restarted). Durable fix needed: bound the activity_execution_traces working set (retention) so the RocksDB footprint stays under the block-cache cap.
